title: *"U.S. Shifts Key Air Defense Assets to Saudi Arabia, Jordan in Tactical Redeployment"*
text:
*"U.S. Shifts Key Air Defense Assets to Saudi Arabia, Jordan in Tactical Redeployment"*"

"**U.S. Army Command Conducts Tactical Withdrawal into Desert Depths**"

"In a significant tactical shift, the U.S. military has relocated its most critical air and air-defense assets to two remote bases: Al-Kharj in Saudi Arabia and Al-Azraq in Jordan."

"While this repositioning places these assets farther from Iran's borders, it simultaneously provides extended reaction time against incoming Iranian projectiles and reduces pressure on both personnel and equipment."

"With the transfer of these assets to the two bases, a new strategic reality has emerged: an unprecedented concentration of air-defense systems and multiple layers of defensive coverage has turned the skies around Al-Kharj and Al-Azraq into one of the most heavily protected airspaces in the world."

"Notably, U.S. forces—having lost the bulk of their ground-based radars in previous strikes—have for the first time designed their entire missile-detection network for launches from Iranian territory using an exclusively airborne-based architecture."

"*— Excerpt from the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) television special program titled "Operation Eagle Eye Hunt"*
